dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: Hello. If you have no business in Tenshukaku, please do not loiter here.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: This is Tenshukaku. As you can see, it stands at the highest point in Inazuma City. It serves as the residence of the most exalted, Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: The Almighty Shogun is someone of immense stature and power, with dominion over all life in Inazuma. Unconcerned persons are not allowed to disturb her.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: I am responsible for the security of Tenshukaku and the surrounding area, maintaining the order around the residence of the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: I and my men only take orders from the Almighty Shogun herself. If you have any requests to make, please see the officers of the Tri-Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: You probably already know about the three major Commissions in charge of Inazuman affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commission, the financial arm of Inazuma. They spare no effort to increase the nation's wealth.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: The Yashiro Commission, the cultural representative of Inazuma. They are responsible for ceremonial affairs and celebratory events. They appear to be the commission closest to the Almighty Shogun herself, so naturally they are also the closest to the people.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission, the head of public security in Inazuma. They carry out government decrees to the T... and then there's the endless tussle with the rebels of Sangonomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: Thankfully they can't easily reassign Hatamoto's forces, otherwise we'd be dragged off to Kannazuka as well.

dialogues.speaker: Naoe Hisamasa
dialogues.text: Anyway... Hmph, as long as it is for the future of Inazuma, I wish them nothing but the best.
